scope: Targeted source review and adversarial regressions by the implementation agent; not an independent or completed protocol audit

findings.boundary: TypeScript Session and Swift WalletSession shutdown
findings.before: A close during request acknowledgement still reached one approval/execution in the controlled fixtures. Per-request approval itself was not bypassed.
findings.repair: Recheck closure/cancellation after asynchronous receive/acknowledgement and before authorization
findings.after: Both regressions pass with zero executions

findings.before: The same request ID in a fresh encrypted frame was accepted when the application constructed a replacement authorizer
findings.repair: Keep a bounded consumed-request set for the entire session independently of the authorizer instance

findings.before: TypeScript accepted noncanonical 16-byte request IDs and measured request size as UTF-16 units rather than UTF-8 bytes
findings.repair: Use canonical fixed-length base64url validation and UTF-8 byte limits
findings.after: Canonical encoding and multibyte size regression passes
